### CMD: ip addr ###
1: lo: <LOOPBACK,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 65536 state UNKNOWN
    inet 127.0.0.1/8 scope host lo
2: eno1: <BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 1500 state UP
    inet 192.168.50.10/24 brd 192.168.50.255 scope global eno1
### CMD: ip route ###
default via 192.168.50.1 dev eno1
192.168.50.0/24 dev eno1 proto kernel scope link src 192.168.50.10
### CMD: ss -tlnp ###

### CMD: cat /etc/resolv.conf ###
